facts.text: Ocean Park once hosted a station on the Ilwaco Railway and Navigation Company, a narrow‑gauge line that ran the Long Beach Peninsula from 1889 to 1930.
The Lamberson Cabin, built in 1883 by Buell Lamberson, stands as Ocean Park’s oldest surviving structure and remains in private family hands.
The Taylor Hotel, erected in 1887, now serves as Adelaide’s Café and Bookstore, honoring the original owner’s wife.
Ocean Park sits on the inland side of the Long Beach Peninsula, overlooking Willapa Bay, formerly called Shoalwater Bay.
During summer Sundays, Vesper services are held at the historic church, which also opens its doors for weddings and community events.
Modern motorists reach Ocean Park by following Sandridge Road north to the Oysterville sign, a simple yet iconic entrance.
